format.summary: Formats a legal process number (processo jurídico) according to a specific pattern.
description: Formats a legal process number with the CNJ mask `NNNNNNN-DD.AAAA.J.TR.OOOO`.
- `options.pad` left-pads the value with zeros to 20 digits first.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #2, #3): the reference (JS) masks an incomplete value as far as it goes and returns an empty string for empty or garbage input; other libs return null.

generate.summary: Generates a random valid Brazilian Processo Jurídico (court case) number, following the `NNNNNNNDDAAAAJTROOOO` layout of Resolução CNJ nº 65/2008.
description: Generates a random valid legal process number (20 digits, unformatted) in the layout of Resolução CNJ nº 65/2008.
- `options.year` sets the `AAAA` field, from the current year to 9999 (default: the current year); `options.court` sets the segment `J`, 1 to 9 (default: random).
- `TR` is drawn among the tribunals of the chosen segment, so the pair always names a court that exists.
- Returns null when the year or the segment is out of range.

tests.name: generated-is-valid
tests.note: every generated value must pass the lib's own validator

isValid.summary: Validates a Brazilian Processo Jurídico (court case) number.
description: Validates a legal process number (Resolução CNJ nº 65/2008): the `NNNNNNN-DD.AAAA.J.TR.OOOO` layout, the `DD` check digits (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10) and the `J`/`TR` pair.
- `J` and `TR` must name a segment and a tribunal that exist; the unidade de origem `OOOO` is only checked as four digits.
- Accepts the 20 digits bare or with the CNJ mask; letters make it invalid.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #7): numbers generated by the reference (JS) for the current year are rejected by Go, Python, Ruby and Rust; the segment/tribunal rules need to be reconciled.
